seed_provenance.derivation: SHA-256 of exact pinned author configuration bytes; no model outcomes or publisher tables used. Fixed development design, not a uniform random seed or proof of representative sampling.
seed_provenance.scope: Public development only, not untouched holdout.

comparison_conditions.default: Same agent and common task constraints without collection instructions or development memory.
comparison_conditions.karpathy: Pinned Karpathy-derived instructions under the same harness and common constraints.
comparison_conditions.collection: A candidate intervention frozen from general skill development before its counted runs; not yet selected or admitted.

native_metrics: Retain the authors original evaluator, acceptance thresholds, result units and denominators. Do not replace fractional native rewards with a custom pass definition.
decision_rule: Development pilot is descriptive only. No superiority, statistical significance or commercial-readiness decision from this selection.
missing_outcomes: Retain every scheduled task and attempt. Unrun, interrupted and infrastructure-failed attempts remain explicit and unscored; never drop them or silently treat them as task failures.
retry_policy: No counted retries or task replacements. Separate diagnostic controls must be labelled and must not overwrite original attempts.
stopping_rule: No early efficacy stop. An isolation failure, authentication/identity change, host resource violation or invalid scorer stops execution; preserve the incomplete schedule and do not claim a complete official suite score.
amendment_rule: Any eligibility, sample, condition, budget, controller or analysis change requires a new version and a recorded reason before new counted outcomes. Preserve the original schedule and evidence.
missing_before_execution: P1 complete launch qualification and supported isolation for the actual sign-in home
Selected task, source revision, image digest, original scorer and runtime qualification
Candidate intervention bytes and pinned reference identity
Per-task common budgets, exact attempt plans and execution-source identities
Verified usage and provider/model identity reporting and complete prospective analysis contract
confirmation_policy: Public development cells are exposed material. Freeze a separately selected untouched confirmation frame and practical/statistical criteria before confirmation outcomes; do not promote this pilot to holdout.
scope: Source-bound local prospective selection; not public timestamp attestation, runtime admission, a complete preregistration or model-performance evidence.
